name: Open Close Store for WooCommerce – Business Hours Schedules Manager
author: ilmosys

sections.description:
Open Close Store for WooCommerce is the best store scheduler plugin in the market which offers you comprehensive business hours management for your WooCommerce store.

Easily set up your store schedule in minutes and choose what days and hours your store is open. Like a real store, your website will open and close following the schedules you define. Your customers will know your actual business hours and won’t be able to place orders when your store is closed.

⭐ Upgrade to Pro | 🚀 Try the Demo | 🛟 Get Support

Perfect for store owners who want to manage their business hours effectively and provide a better shopping experience for their customers.

🎥 Plugin Overview

🚀 Key Features

  • Flexible Schedule Management – Create unlimited schedules with multiple daily shifts for complete business hour control
  • Smart Order Blocking – Automatically prevent orders when your store is closed with customizable customer notifications
  • Instant Store Control – Open or close your store instantly with a single click for unexpected changes
  • Frontend Schedule Display – Show your business hours beautifully on any page with customizable widgets
  • Dynamic Countdown Timers – Display stylish countdown timers showing when your store reopens
  • Multi-Location Support – Manage different schedules for multiple store locations or departments
  • Timezone Compatibility – Automatically adjust to your WordPress timezone settings
  • Customer-Friendly Notifications – Display informative notice bars and popups about store status

⭐ PRO Features

  • Advanced Pre-Order System – Accept pre-orders for specific products when your store is temporarily closed
  • Enhanced Pre-Order Options – Customizable pre-order messages and button text
  • Intelligent Cart Management – Automatically empty cart or allow specific products during store closure
  • 24/7 Operation Mode – Keep your store open 24 hours with per-day toggle options
  • Advanced Frontend Manager – Manage schedules directly from the frontend with an intuitive interface
  • Instant Override Controls – Force your store open or closed instantly with custom messages
  • Selective Product Availability – Allow or disallow specific products based on store status
  • Multivendor Integration – Full Dokan marketplace support for vendor-specific schedules

🔄 Plugin Integrations

Dokan Multivendor Marketplace

Full compatibility with Dokan, allowing each vendor to set their own store hours.

⚙️ Shortcodes

Display Single Schedule

[schedule id="71"]

Display a specific schedule anywhere on your site. Replace “71” with your actual schedule ID.

Frontend Schedule Manager (Pro)

[wooopenclose-manage-schedules]

Allow administrators to manage store schedules directly from the frontend. Create, update, or delete schedules without accessing the WordPress admin.

Countdown Timer

[wooopenclose-countdown]

Show a countdown timer until the store reopens. Customize the appearance in the plugin settings.

Today’s Hours

[wooopenclose-today]

Display today’s store hours in a clean, easy-to-read format.

Is Open/Closed Status

Show whether your store is currently open or closed based on your schedule.

  • Custom Product Tabs for WooCommerce
  • Quick Buy Now Button for WooCommerce
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Open Close Store to configure your store hours and settings.
  4. Set up your business hours, messages, and notification preferences.
  5. Use the provided shortcodes to display your store hours anywhere on your site.
  6. Save your settings and your store will now follow the defined schedule automatically.
sections.faq:
How does the store scheduling work?

The plugin allows you to set specific days and hours when your store is open. During closed hours, you can choose to disable purchases, show a notice, or allow pre-orders.

Will this plugin work with my timezone?

Yes! The plugin automatically uses your WordPress timezone settings. You can find these settings at Settings > General > Timezone in your WordPress admin panel.

Does it work with WordPress Multisite?

Yes! The plugin is fully compatible with WordPress Multisite installations.

Is it compatible with my theme?

The plugin is compatible with most WordPress and WooCommerce themes. If you encounter any issues, our support team is ready to help.

Can I set different hours for different days?

Yes! You can set unique schedules for each day of the week, with multiple time slots per day if needed.

Is this plugin available in my language?

The plugin is translation ready. You can contribute translations at WordPress Translate.
